== Build notes ==

New article, 11 November 2026. Sources are the Steam store page for Tabletop Simulator and the listed Steam Workshop item pages. Direct Wayback captures of the Steam store and Steam Community hosts were not reliably available, so Route C snapshots were built under snapshots/steam/ on swccg.com and cited through their Wayback captures. No card-scan images were added. Workshop author handles are given as they appear on those pages; no person-page identification was attempted.

The wiki's published GEMP-importable .txt files use a different XML attribute order than the one the HiRez Deck Importer's pattern expects, so those Media files cannot be pasted unchanged. That format question is left for a later pass.
